candidate.text: Puri’s Bring Your Own Film Festival offers a local example of making room for films together. In a 2015 interview, its organisers described screenings without selections or juries. A 2005 report records filmmaker Sammit Das’s short being shown the previous year and Pankaj Advani contributing to the festival fund. These are modest, concrete forms of participation: bringing a film, giving it attention and helping sustain the gathering. They offer something a community can learn from without turning every encounter into a competition.
